formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj],   (∀ (x4 x5 x6 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x4 x5 → x2.Adj x5 x6 → ¬x2.Adj x6 x4) →     PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle x2 →       have x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → ℕ := fun (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => {x7 : ℕ | x7 < x6.gates.length ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x6 x7).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ∀ (x8 x9 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x8 x9 → ¬PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x6 x7 x8 x9}.ncard;       ∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.IsMinimalMonoCircuit x1 x7 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x7 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ → ∀ x10 < x7.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x7 x10).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → (∀ (x13 x14 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x13 x14 → ¬PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x7 x10 x13 x14) → (∀ x14 < x10, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x7 x14).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ (x17 : Fin x1) (x18 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x17 x18 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.Owns x1 x7 x14 x17 x18) → ∀ (x15 x16 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x15 x16 → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal x1 x7 x10 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x15 x16) = Bool.true → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 (PEqualNP.CircuitMoves.eraseGate x1 x7 x10 (x1 + x7.gates.length)) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x15 x16) = Bool.false → ∃ (x20 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x20 ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x20 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ ∧ x20.size ≤ x7.size ∧ x6 x20 < x6 x7
plain_statement: A graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle; C a least circuit of AND and OR gates (at most two inputs a gate) for its edge function; an AND gate that owns no edge while every earlier AND gate owns one, and that is needed at some edge. Then some circuit of that kind for the function, no larger, has fewer AND gates that own no edge.
